firm_data.firm_description: Littleton Joyce Ughetta & Kelly LLP represents corporate clients in complex litigation across the country. The firm combines the attributes of a boutique with the ability to manage national cases for global corporations.
notable_facts: The firm has seven offices in the U.S.
Kristen E. Dennison was named a BTI Client Service All-Star in 2025.
C. Scott Toomey received the BTI Client Service All-Star award in 2024.

email.subject: AI for Littleton Joyce Ughetta & Kelly LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kristen,

Managing national product liability and mass tort cases across seven offices takes the precision of a boutique with BigLaw-scale operations. That's exactly the tension we solve for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing complex litigation demands with lean teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and efficiency without the enterprise overhead.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Purchase office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, document review, and case strategy.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
